name: spa-kit
description: A factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read. Generates a standalone Next.js site from a declarative brief — deriving the whole OKLCH colour ramp from one brand hex with enforced contrast targets — then verifies it with three independent oracles: an SEO/AEO probe that fetches every route as GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot with no JavaScript engine at all; a blind breaker that receives only the contract and a live URL and attacks it with falsifying request vectors; and a Playwright suite covering smoke, deterministic visual regression, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, a two-way reduced-motion contract and web-vitals budgets. The generated site has no dependency on this plugin and deploys anywhere. Includes the /spa-kit skill, which turns the whole thing into an interview.
